description: Create a free private veteran review PDF for the selected saved review. Requires owner:read. Missing answers appear as questions to review. A VA connection is optional; using connected facts requires owner:va and the user's explicit choice for this applicant. Extra answers are user reports and are not saved to the review. Returns a protected, expiring PDF download. The draft does not complete an official application, decide eligibility, estimate savings or file anything.

use_connected_va_records.description: Only true when the user explicitly asks to use their connected records for their own applicant review; requires additional owner:va permission and is_surviving_spouse=false.

name: generate_veteran_packet
